title: Seed the shared model from the twelve model repositories
summary: Adds the claims two or more frameworks share, worded neutrally, every contradiction between them as open claims joined by contradicts or is_in_tension_with, the recorded failures of every framework (vibe included) as rejected, and proposes integration for a small set of claims with recorded evidence.

changes.reason: Two experiments: a bioelectric perturbation gave stable two-headed planaria that kept the plan through later cuts and reverted when the state was reversed, and a gap junction block gave heads of other species, both with an unchanged genome.

A worked example: four noisy AND gates have 1.15 bits of effective information at the micro level and 1.55 bits at a two-element macro level. The claim is scoped to the stated convention, which the normalization critique disputes as a measure of causation, not as arithmetic.

fMRI of masked against visible words, and high-density ERPs across finely varied masking intervals, both show early sensory processing of stimuli that are not reported. Both global workspace theory and analytic idealism accept this finding and read it differently.

Preregistered adversarial test: 25 of 657 posterior intracranial electrodes showed sustained activity tracking stimulus duration, passing the preregistered IIT duration criterion. Only 8 of 53 face-selective electrodes were sustained, so the claim is scoped to some posterior sites.

TMS with high-density EEG found a local, short response in NREM sleep against a spreading one in wakefulness, and the perturbational complexity index separated wakefulness, sleep, three anesthetics and post-coma patients individually. The finding is integrated, not the IIT reading of it: the observations name Tononi and Massimini as co-authors.

parts: the neutral wording of every shared claim
every link rationale not copied from a model repository
every proposed integration and its reason
